dogecoin.text: Even though my investment in Dogecoin increased my total assets by 8% in just four days, I still felt regret when selling, thinking, "It could have gone higher"… Sigh, mindset is such a tricky thing.
@JakeGagain Counterpoint: Memecoin season feels late cycle. Better alpha in low-cap DeFi gems with actual revenue models right now. $RLB > $DOGE change my mind.
